title: FILL ITEMS, GASOLINE & MISC.
summary: Fill items: antifreeze 9985012 (140a, cooling system), gasoline 9985015 (141a, at the filler neck), windshield washer solvent 9985129 (143a), liquid wax 9985022 (147a, hand-applied to the soft top), cooling-system sealer 1163105 (149a, put in the radiator) and A/C refrigerant 9985016 (150a). Note A: initial cold fill to 3 in. below the filler neck; open the water temperature control valve fully when filling.
notes: [A] QUANTITY OF INITIAL COLD FILL TO BE THREE INCHES BELOW BOTTOM OF FILLER NECK IN LINE WITH COLD FILL LEVEL.
NOTE Fully open water temperature control valve when filling to minimize trapped air.
notes_internal: Chart sheet (no drawing, no callouts): applied-material codes. PART cell = GM part number + description from the left column, repeated on every row of its group (on the page it is printed once per group).
Words hyphenated across line breaks in USAGE are joined (e.g. RE-/TAINER -> RETAINER); multi-line cells joined with a space.
Model box reads 19000 (all models), so models = [].
[A] in 140a usage is a boxed note flag pointing to note A at the bottom of the sheet.
149a UPC: middle wiped out by the binder hole; visible '1' ... '3' (likely 11-13 like 140a, not inferred); written '1?-?3'.
1163105 first digit at the edge of the binder hole but legible.
Rev 1 date: first part reads 11 or 12; written '1?-11-69'. Circled 1 beside 143a; circled 2 beside note A.
